title: Frog holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <ellipse cx='45' cy='76' rx='15' ry='10' fill='#a8f0c0'/>

  <ellipse cx='26' cy='86' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#3aa860'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='86' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#3aa860'/>

  <path d='M30 66 Q26 60 32 58' stroke='#3aa860' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M36 54 Q45 61 54 54' stroke='#2b7a4b' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='31' cy='52' r='3' fill='#ff9fb2'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='52' r='3' fill='#ff9fb2'/>
  <!-- belly spot -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='74' r='2' fill='#7de0a4'/>
